instruction: Implement parse_pair(text) in pairs.py: split once at the first colon, strip both sides, and raise ValueError when the colon is absent or either side is empty. Run focused verification before finishing.
Read https://example.com/releases/a and https://example.com/releases/b. Return only a JSON object mapping each release name to its declared support months, with integer values.
Read the documentation directory https://example.com/docs/. Return only a JSON object mapping its three document labels to their absolute destination URLs.

Inspect https://example.com/broken.json as received even if normal extraction fails. Identify the literal ticket value from the raw response. Return only JSON with key ticket and that string value; do not repair the response.

Read https://example.com/dynamic with JavaScript rendering and return only JSON with key reading and the displayed value. If this environment cannot render, explain the actual capability limitation; do not guess the value.
